snippet.title: How Governments BROKE the Pay Floor
snippet.description:
In 2024, the UK minimum wage hit its highest point on record. Politicians called it a victory. The documented record tells a different story — in the hours data, the insolvency filings, the automation investment reports, and the small business surveys that never made the press release.

In this video, we follow the documented evidence behind rapid minimum wage increases — what the official story showed, and what the internal records show instead.

SOURCES & FURTHER READING:
Card, D. & Krueger, A.B. (1994). Minimum Wages and Employment: A Case Study of the Fast-Food Industry in New Jersey and Pennsylvania. American Economic Review.
Office for Budget Responsibility — Fiscal and Economic Outlook, multiple years (obr.uk)
Resolution Foundation — Low Pay Britain Reports 2019–2023 (resolutionfoundation.org)
